2608.28578.title: Aero Hand Open: A Simulation-Ready Tendon-Driven Hand for Dexterous Manipulation Learning
2608.28578.paper_summary: Tendon-driven hands are anthropomorphic, and moving the actuators off the joints is what makes a hand of this capability affordable to build. Two effects produce that saving. Routing force through a cable removes the requirement that a motor fit inside the joint it drives, so smaller and cheaper motors suffice, and one motor can drive several joints through a single cable, so fewer motors are needed. They are also harder to learn on than a direct-drive hand. The underactuated transmission that produces the saving is itself difficult to represent in a simulator, and the joints one cable drives are not independently commandable. We present Aero Hand Open, a tendon-driven anthropomorphic hand that is released simulation-ready. Three things ship with it. A simulation model reproduces the cable transmission itself. An identified actuation map connects that model to the motor commands in both directions, including the three-way coupling of the thumb. A reinforcement learning package trains policies for the hand. Together they let a policy be trained entirely in simulation and run on the hand with no fine-tuning and no state estimation. We release the mechanical design, the simulation model, the identified mapping, the training environment and the deployment stack.
2608.28578.paper_summary_zh: 肌腱驅動的手是類人型的，將驅動器移出關節使得這種能力的手變得可負擔建造。這種節省是由兩個效應產生的。通過電纜傳遞力量消除了馬達必須安裝在其驅動的關節內的要求，因此可以使用更小且更便宜的馬達，並且一個馬達可以通過一根電纜驅動多個關節，因此需要的馬達更少。它們也比直接驅動的手更難學習。產生節省的欠驅動傳動系統本身在模擬器中難以表示，而一根電纜驅動的關節也無法獨立控制。我們推出了Aero Hand Open，一款已經準備好進行模擬的肌腱驅動類人手。隨之而來的有三樣東西。一個模擬模型再現了電纜傳動系統本身。一個識別的驅動映射將該模型與馬達命令雙向連接，包括拇指的三向耦合。一個強化學習包訓練手的策略。這三者一起使得策略可以完全在模擬中訓練，並在手上運行，無需微調和狀態估計。我們發布了機械設計、模擬模型、識別映射、訓練環境和部署堆棧。
